settings.label: Criteria weights
settings.description: Optional weights over normalized unit-safe criteria only, shared by every role below; raw accuracy, index, latency, and price units cannot be combined.

settings.label: Media backend
settings.description: Where image and sampled-video analysis runs in an isolated sandbox. Auto follows the billing policy.

settings.label: Media billing policy
settings.description: Session only prevents interact's metered API fallback; vendor CLI account credits are separate — see the confirmation below.

settings.label: No-extra-usage confirmed providers
settings.description: Claude confirmation: Usage credits disabled, zero prepaid balance, and auto-reload off. Unconfirmed providers still run, with one warning per process. interact cannot verify this account state.

settings.label: Subscription provider order
settings.description: Media-capable subscription CLI, currently Claude.

settings.label: Claude session model criteria
settings.description: Requirement the Claude CLI's own model must clear (e.g. 'cap.vlm'); blank uses the subscription CLI default.

settings.label: Sovereign-tier criteria
settings.description: Requirement for review_ui/verify_ui's low/medium quality tier (cheapest clearing model wins — self-hosted sorts first at zero cost); blank means any VLM.

settings.label: Vision model criteria
settings.description: Requirement for screenshots and images (e.g. 'cap.vlm and aa.intelligence > 80%'); blank means any VLM. Subscription sessions use media.claudeCriteria instead.

settings.label: Component model criteria
settings.description: Requirement for GUI grounding (falls back to cap.gui_grounding). Subscription sessions use their media session model.

settings.label: Video model criteria
settings.description: Requirement for video (falls back to cap.video). Subscription sessions always receive ordered, timestamped sampled frames; an API model may receive native video when supported.

settings.label: Audio model criteria
settings.description: Requirement for transcribe (falls back to cap.audio). Claude subscription sessions do not hear audio; media.billing must allow this separate path.

settings.label: Desktop target
settings.description: Where desktop automation acts: your real session, or an isolated sandbox.

settings.label: Nested headless
settings.description: Sandbox only: ON = Xvfb in the background (CI/servers); OFF = Xephyr you can watch.

settings.label: Nested display
settings.description: X display number for the sandbox (e.g. 99 → :99).

settings.label: Nested size
settings.description: Sandbox screen size, WIDTHxHEIGHT.

settings.label: Browser headless
settings.description: Run the automation browser without a visible window.

settings.label: Browser engine
settings.description: Which Playwright engine drives browser automation.

settings.label: Viewport width
settings.description: Browser viewport width in pixels.

settings.label: Viewport height
settings.description: Browser viewport height in pixels.

settings.label: Slow-mo (ms)
settings.description: Delay added between browser actions, in ms (0 = full speed; useful when watching).

settings.label: Persistent profile dir
settings.description: When set, browser sessions keep their cookies/login on disk here (under <dir>/<session>) so you log in once and stay authenticated across restarts — run authenticated flows through the reliable DOM-ref path instead of driving a logged-in desktop browser window. Blank = ephemeral (logged out every launch).

settings.label: VLM max tokens
settings.description: Cap on VLM output tokens per call (blank = the model's default).

settings.label: Subscription media timeout (s)
settings.description: Hard limit for a Claude media-analysis child process.

settings.label: Media items per request
settings.description: Maximum number of image, video, or audio items accepted in one analysis.

settings.label: Media bytes per request
settings.description: Maximum aggregate decoded media bytes accepted before any provider runs.

settings.label: Media context characters
settings.description: Maximum untrusted page, title, URL, or transcript context characters per request.

settings.label: Action wait timeout (ms)
settings.description: How long a browser action waits for its target before failing (default 10000).

settings.label: Video FPS
settings.description: Frames per second sampled from a recording for analysis.

settings.label: Video duration (s)
settings.description: Default desktop recording length, in seconds.

settings.label: Debug / output dir
settings.description: Where interact writes logs + debug artifacts (blank = ~/.interact/out; point at a project's out/ when working locally).
